# Tech&Res politics: pole ideologies of interest groups - GENERATED by .claude/skills/ztr_politics/scripts/ztrpol_gen_ig_pole_ideologies.py, do not edit by hand

# Country, yearly after ztrpol_update_pole: each eligible IG rolls its chance, one of the successful ones changes through ztrpol_ig_ideology.1
ztrpol_ig_ideology_yearly = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			ztrpol_pole_ideologies_enabled_trigger = yes
			ztrpol_ig_pole_gate_trigger = yes
			NOT = {
				has_variable = ztrpol_tr_pending
			}
		}
		every_interest_group = {
			remove_variable = ztrpol_tr_chosen
			ztrpol_ig_find_transformation = yes
		}
		random_interest_group = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = ztrpol_tr_rolled
			}
			set_variable = ztrpol_tr_chosen
			save_scope_as = ztrpol_ig
		}
		every_interest_group = {
			remove_variable = ztrpol_tr_rolled
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = {
						has_variable = ztrpol_tr_chosen
					}
				}
				remove_variable = ztrpol_tr_id
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:ztrpol_ig
			}
			# Country copy of the id, read by the event localization
			set_variable = {
				name = ztrpol_tr_id
				value = scope:ztrpol_ig.var:ztrpol_tr_id
			}
			# Expires if the event is never answered
			set_variable = {
				name = ztrpol_tr_pending
				value = yes
				days = 365
			}
			trigger_event = {
				id = ztrpol_ig_ideology.1
				popup = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

ztrpol_ig_roll_transformation = {
	set_variable = {
		name = ztrpol_tr_id
		value = $ID$
	}
	random = {
		chance = $CHANCE$
		set_variable = ztrpol_tr_rolled
	}
}

# Interest group: the change itself, from the event option
ztrpol_apply_ig_transformation = {

		limit = {
			var:ztrpol_tr_id = 1

		}
		remove_ideology = ideology_proletarian
		add_ideology = ideology_ztrpol_social_democratic_labor
		set_ig_trait = ig_trait:ig_trait_ztrpol_social_partnership

	else_if = {
